solution_summary: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities are evolving daily, requiring companies to rapidly adapt to recent advances. Daxte used this new technology to create LegalMap —one of the first French generative AI solutions for legal documents. To develop AI models for its solution, the company fine-tuned open-source large language models such as Llama2 7b from Hugging Face with its own datasets and used Amazon SageMaker , a fully managed service that brings together a broad set of tools to provide high-performance, low-cost machine learning. “Using Amazon SageMaker, we can manage, develop, test, and deploy our AI models efficiently,” says Arnaud de La Bédoyère, founder of Daxte.
